defect: In the second member loop the member with a mismatched key kind is skipped only when its integer key is null (if (intKey is null)), so a member with a missing string key is not skipped and reaches stringMembers.
why: The skip must cover both mismatch cases the diagnostic reports, as in the first loop; a null string key then reaches the dictionary again and throws, the failure the change is meant to remove (F2, N1).
